cv_depth.note: Storage is ready for metric CV/depth outputs. Current curb/sidewalk rows are simulation seeds or depth backlog, not exact measured curb heights.

street_furniture.storage_note: Street furniture is published as a lazy sidecar and is not embedded in sf-corridor-3d.json.

waterline.note: cells inside the map's closed water polygons, and on the seaward side of its coastlines, were set to the water surface the lidar measured whatever the grid's fill had them at; the renderer draws the sea at and under that surface

terrain.source: USGS 3DEP CA_SanFrancisco_1_B23 ground returns (class 2), via Entwine
